name: print-social-church-service-posts-dark-green-with-mid-century-shapes
title: Church service pack in dark green and beige with half-circles, sparkles and bold serif
whatItIs: Five posts in deep green and beige: 'Sundays Are For Serenity' in bold white serif, a photo of hands holding a Bible and rosary, service times '8hrs 12hrs 18hrs', mint and brown half-circles, four-point sparkles and dot grids.
whatItMeans: Calm, modern and welcoming; mid-century shapes make a church feel fresh without losing warmth.
techniques: Use earthy half-circles as quiet decoration.
List times in a large stacked serif column.
Place a rounded photo inside a beige band.
Add small sparkles for a hint of the sacred.

vocabulary.definition: Simple arcs and circles in muted retro tones.
Items set one per line as a column.
